data.one_liner: Dependent library for Syncfusion Flutter XlsIO and OfficeChart.
data.what_it_does: Provides core foundational logic and dependencies required by Syncfusion Flutter XlsIO and OfficeChart packages for creating and manipulating Excel and office documents.
use_when: You are using syncfusion_flutter_xlsio to create or edit Excel files from scratch
avoid_when: You are not using any Syncfusion office-related packages
You require an open-source or non-commercial library
strengths: Natively written in Dart for creating Excel from scratch
Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux
weaknesses: Commercial package requiring a Syncfusion commercial or community license
Primarily a dependent internal library rather than a standalone developer-facing package
data.setup_notes: Requires obtaining a Syncfusion license to legally use in production.
